pont.name: Le Pont · Bridge of Opposites
pont.alt: A bridge of two halves over the park pond on a sunny day, painted in ink and gouache: the left half is pale white stone with a glowing gold sun lantern on its parapet, the right half is black stone with a silver crescent-moon lantern. On the parapets a tiny mouse sips from a little cup and a happy dog wags its tail at a giant bone; a June bug in a cap skateboards past an old man with a long white beard dozing in a deckchair. A boy shows off a shiny new red bike while a man holds up a toothy mauve hat, a tall giraffe in the pond bends to drink, and an old weed-hung galleon floats behind. At the front a shivering cat in a striped scarf faces a sweating fire-juggler. The wooden gate on the left leads back to the park; two round stone huts have three colored doors each: red, yellow and blue on the left, green, orange and white on the right.

sous.name: Sous le pont · Under the Bridge
sous.alt: The riverbank under a three-arched stone bridge, painted in ink and gouache; its left half is white stone with a gold sun lantern and its right half black stone with a silver moon lantern. A girl on top of the bridge flies a kite high in the sky; below, a fisherman in a rowing boat coaxes a grumpy seal while another seal balances a ball on its nose. A cheetah races along the bank past a slow snail, a very long sausage dog stretches along the grass and a short dachshund stands by a little tennis net. A sheep bleats on the bottom step, an old fisherman's rod bends double, hooked onto a heavy black iron kettlebell sunk into the grass, and a feather quill rests on an open ledger. A weeping willow stands on the right; the red door in the bridge wall on the left leads back up to the bridge.

doors.label: Le Pont des Contraires
doors.hint: Go back through the red door to the bridge

marche.name: Le marché · Bridge Market
marche.alt: A little market on a cobbled quay beside the pond, painted in ink and gouache. A plane overloaded with suitcases flies overhead with a giraffe poking out of the top; an actor in a ruff polishes a shiny crown, a pig wallows in mud and a strongman lifts a whole castle. An open, empty fridge has a picture of a roast on its door, a thin thin gray cat sits by an empty saucer under a little rain cloud, a skinny boy strains to lift a feather in front of a flexing sturdy boy, and a gentleman in a top hat reaches down for a gold coin in the water. A little girl gasps at an open cupboard stall of jars beside a padlocked shed, and fruit and flower stalls fill the right. The yellow door of the little stone hut on the left leads back to the bridge.

doors.label: Le Pont des Contraires
doors.hint: Go back through the yellow door to the bridge

jardin.name: Le jardin · Garden of Moods
jardin.alt: A cottage garden full of moods, painted in ink and gouache. A donkey brays beside an honest boy holding a flowerpot, a giant pumpkin squashes the fence and a puppy spins with a red ball. A willow droops under its own rain cloud, a postman's false mustache flies off, and a thin mantis slips through the mail slot of a green door. A sad clown holds the scraps of his burst balloons, a tailor measures a wide sofa, a goat sings as it rides the swinging gate, and three cats squeeze through a narrow gap by the gate post. The blue door on the left leads back to the bridge.

doors.label: Le Pont des Contraires
doors.hint: Go back through the blue door to the bridge

ponton.name: Le ponton · Jetty
ponton.alt: A wooden jetty winding across a reedy pond, painted in ink and gouache. Ants carry a sandwich along the planks, a beaver bites a rock on the bank and a girl holds up a clear glass of water. A dove settles on a fluffy pillow, a pig with paper wings flies over ducks holding blank cards, and a calm grandpa dozes in a deckchair near a shivering chihuahua. An old lady gasps at a huge blank price tag on a teapot, a vendor hands a toddler an ice cream, and a lamplighter climbs a ladder to the only glowing lamp under a dark tree. The green door of the shed on the left leads back to the bridge.

doors.label: Le Pont des Contraires
doors.hint: Go back through the green door to the bridge

quai.name: Le quai · Quay
quai.alt: A sunny stone quay curving round a lake, painted in ink and gouache. Far out on the water a lion lounges on a tiny palm island; a prince in a red cape admires his bow tie in a standing mirror, and a camel with a sack crosses dry cracked ground. A boy holds his umbrella over an old man, a black cat nips a yelping dog and another cat creeps close to a crystal fishbowl. An owl sits quietly on a post beside a honking goose, a warty troll leans on the quay wall from the lake, a wet dog shakes water over a laughing cow, and a boy bangs a pot while his family covers their ears. The orange door of the boathouse on the left leads back to the bridge.

doors.label: Le Pont des Contraires
doors.hint: Go back through the orange door to the bridge

passerelle.name: La passerelle · Footbridge
passerelle.alt: A flat wooden footbridge over a stream in the park, painted in ink and gouache. A chef offers plain crackers on a plate, a girl shoots her hand up while a teacher checks the register, and a golden frog on the footbridge is admired by two young bird-watchers with binoculars. A glass urn full of neon squiggles stands by a cracked Roman vase, a girl in a lace bonnet and clogs dances toward a breakdancing robot, and a woman untangles fairy lights wrapped round a cat. An absent-minded professor strolls along reading with a teapot on his head, and pigeons crowd round an old man on a bench. The white door of the little shed on the left leads back to the bridge.

doors.label: Le Pont des Contraires
doors.hint: Go back through the white door to the bridge
